prompts.foundation: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent skin foundation layer for a 2D anime talking character rig. Input image 1 is the edit target: the original 380x450 head crop of a blonde blue-eyed female android. Create ONLY her hairless, featureless face and bare head skin, with her small original nose retained. Remove all hair, both eyes including lashes, eyebrows and mouth, replacing them with smoothly continuous original peach skin. Also remove the white mechanical ear covers and all robot collar/neck/body pixels: skin head only. Reconstruct the forehead and hidden cranium naturally behind the former fringe. Preserve the original face width, jaw silhouette, chin, camera angle and delicate soft painted shading. Face is centered at image x180, chin at y370, visible cheek width about 200 pixels; reconstructed crown near y85. No expression, no eyes, no brows, no mouth. True transparent background, no flat color, no checkerboard, no labels or extra elements. The original nose and jaw must look like exactly the same character, not a different person. Output square with generous transparent margin, a single skin head aligned front-on for registration; not a sheet.
prompts.eyes: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas of six pairs of eyes for a 2D talking anime android. Input image 1 is the original character reference. Generate ONLY six matched left/right eye pairs, with the identical saturated blue irises, black-brown lashes, white sclera, delicate linework and soft shading as the reference. No surrounding face, skin blocks, eyebrows, hair, nose, text, or glow. A regular 2 column x 3 row grid on TRUE TRANSPARENCY, equal size cells, generous spacing. Both eyes stay together at the same consistent spacing and width in all cells. Reading order top-left to bottom-right: 1 normal fully open (size calibration); 2 half-closed about 50% lid opening (blink intermediate); 3 completely closed relaxed lids as gently downward curved fine lash lines; 4 completely closed smiling eyes as upward arch lash curves; 5 wide-open surprised eyes with same blue irises; 6 gentle slightly narrowed happy open eyes. Closed eyes have NO iris and NO sclera. Preserve consistent pupil position, angle, symmetric head-forward perspective, stroke weight and pair centers. Each pair must be cleanly isolated with transparent pixels around it. These are production parts, not faces. Output 1536x1536 atlas if possible.
prompts.mouths: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent mouth sprite atlas for Japanese lip sync and emotions in an anime android rig. Input image 1 is the original character face reference. Create nine isolated small delicate anime mouths matching her soft peach shading and fine muted red-brown linework. True TRANSPARENT background everywhere outside lips/mouth interiors, no face, no skin patches, no nose, no text, no grid lines, no labels. Regular 3x3 evenly spaced grid, common drawing scale. Reading order: top row 1 relaxed closed tiny neutral line (ん / rest), 2 slightly open small talking mouth, 3 あ broad vertical open oval with upper teeth and soft pink tongue; middle row 4 い horizontally stretched teeth gently together (narrow gap, distinct from え), 5 う small pursed round mouth, 6 え wider relaxed horizontal opening showing upper teeth; bottom row 7 お rounded large O opening, 8 closed gentle smiling mouth with upward corners, 9 downturned small sad mouth. Minimal lip outline, NO human realistic lipstick. Mouth interior must remain opaque while outside is transparent. Keep widths naturally different for vowels using a shared scale, not filling each cell equally. Clean production sprites to be reduced to 15-35 pixels wide on the original face.
prompts.brows: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent eyebrow sprite atlas for same blonde anime android reference. Produce SIX pairs of delicate thin blonde/light-brown eyebrows, left and right together, on actual transparent background. A regular 2-column by 3-row grid, consistent pair spacing, width, alignment and drawing scale. Reading order: normal level eyebrows; joyful soft arches; angry brows angled down toward the nose; sad brows higher at inner ends; puzzled one raised and one level; worried inner ends raised with soft curve. Match the original fine muted brown linework, not thick black eyebrows. ONLY eyebrow lines, no eye, eyelid, eyelashes, face, skin patch, hair, nose, words, labels, glow or backdrop. Very clean small sprites. Each pair has generous transparent separation from every other pair.
prompts.faceColors: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent skin-head atlas of emotion face-color variants, for a composited talking anime character. Image 1 is the exact blank face/head edit target with nose. Make a regular 2x2 sprite atlas with four copies of EXACTLY this same front-facing bald skin head. IDENTICAL outlines, nose position and shading structure in all four cells; generous transparent separation. No ears protruding outside the head, no neck, eyes, mouth, brows, hair or body. Reading order 1 neutral original peach skin for size calibration; 2 blushing embarrassed, pink-red face and visibly flushed cheeks, still soft natural anime shading; 3 shocked/dismayed pale complexion and soft blue-violet shadow across upper forehead fading toward cheeks; 4 ill/unwell face with softly desaturated pale green tint. True transparency outside each head. Preserve small nose and original jaw/chin character identity. No letters, captions, grid lines, background or decorations. Shared rendering scale, keep four matching face shapes. Heads are intended for overlay under existing original eye, brow, mouth and hair layers.
prompts.point: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent body pose replacement for a 2D anime robot narrator rig. Image 1 is the original full character reference. Create the SAME female android BODY ONLY from its black mechanical neck down to both white shoes, no head, face or hair. Keep original slender proportions, white pearl armor panels, black visible mechanics, shoulder circles, hip shapes, segmented limbs, blue-gray painted shadows and meticulous original anime illustration style. Pose: explain a point by raising HER RIGHT ARM on SCREEN LEFT, bend elbow naturally and point index finger upward and toward SCREEN LEFT. Other arm remains relaxed. Both legs remain straight, planted close together like original. Torso faces front, neck collar center remains same, no body twist. Include entire raised hand, neck collar, and both feet with transparent margin; actual transparent background, no text/objects. A single tall portrait sprite. Preserve the tiny black neck stub and white high collar connection so the original head can be attached. No head, no hair, no floating head above it, no missing fingers, no extra limbs.

prompts.cleanHair: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent hair layer for this exact 2D anime character. Correct the extracted hair layer: retain the blonde bob hairstyle, long central curved fringe, thin strands on both sides over forehead, outer silhouette and original detailed painted colors, shadows and highlights, and both white mechanical ear covers. Remove ALL remaining skin, eyebrow, eye, lash, lip, nose, chin/jaw-outline pixels and all small isolated light flecks inside the face opening. Only hair and the two mechanical ear covers may remain.
